description: Source code for the User class in the Cart library of the OpenCart System, handling user authentication, session management, and permissions.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the shopping cart context, managing authentication, permissions, and session data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the User object with dependencies from the registry and loads session data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates the user with username and password, updating session and permissions.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user session data and resets user properties.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission key with a given value.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns true if a user is currently logged in.
